[[Vassal States]] | followed by = | map = [[File:Vassal States (Hard mode) Luxon.jpg|180px]] | map2 = [[File:Vassal States (Hard mode) Kurzick.jpg|240px]] }} Attend to the needs of the vassal states, by expelling the Am Fah and Jade Brotherhood from the Jade Sea and Echovald Forest respectively. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Go to the [[Raisu Pavilion|palace]] and talk to the diplomats. * Clear out the remaining Am Fah from the Jade Sea. * Clear out the remaining Jade Brotherhood from the Echovald Forest. * Tell the diplomats that their lands are clear. * See Lei Jeng for your reward. ===Reward=== * 5,000 [[Experience]] * 2,000 [[Gold]] * [[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] * [[Imperial Commendation]] ==Walkthrough== While similar in all respects to the [[normal mode]] version of this quest, there are now seven groups that you must defeat in each area. The last two or three groups are found in areas where that are rather crowded with enemies. Consider taking advantage of the fact that the quest groups are hostile to everything else. Also consider [[vanquishing]] the zones if you need them for the title, since you will be traveling all over the map and it will be hard to avoid aggroing a large number of foes. ==See also== * Quest walkthrough, NPCs, dialogue, and notes can be found on [[Vassal States]].
